channel.description: Latest articles from News Talk 980 CKNW (cknw.com)

item.title: Winnipeg man charged with sexual abuse of two youths
item.description: Two separate cases of child sexual abuse last year have resulted in an arrest.

item.title: ‘I felt like a nobody’: Woman says care denied without reason at Pincher Creek hospital
item.description: A Pincher Creek woman says she was turned away from the southern Alberta town's hospital without a reason and without care, despite having a genuine medical need to be there.

item.title: Two teens arrested in connection with First Nation double homicide in northern Quebec
item.description: The two male victims died after being found in a bullet-riddled car on Wednesday night in the First Nations community about 600 kilometres northwest of Quebec City.

item.title: Saskatchewan alumina deposit discovery a ‘potential gamechanger’
item.description: An estimated 6.8 billion tonne alumina deposit was found near Tisdale, being a new resource for Sask. it will provide economic benefits as it is holds a third of global reserves

item.title: New business CCTV registry rolled out by City of Kelowna prompts concerns
item.description: 'It doesn’t take a lot of research to find out that nothing new is coming to the table,' said Todd Daniels, owner of Gallery Streetwear in downtown Kelowna.

item.title: Jurisdictional gaps blamed for fire risk at, near Penticton homeless encampment
item.description: Despite signage prohibiting fire activity in the area, three blazes have erupted at the encampment in just the past two weeks.

item.title: Owners of Calgary jewelry store say they were scammed thousands during POS purchase
item.description: Calgary police have confirmed that they have received the report and that the incident is under investigation.

item.title: Calgary man in life-threatening condition after crash involving motorized scooter
item.description: Calgary police said an elderly man was rushed to hospital, where he's in life-threatening condition following a crash between a scooter and a vehicle on Wednesday.

item.title: North Bay edges London Knights 3-2 in a shootout
item.description: The North Bay Battalion got shootout goals from Nick Wellenreiter and Kaden Pitre to get by the London Knights on Jan. 30, 2026.

item.title: Read the full transcript of Poilievre’s speech to Conservative convention
item.description: Conservative Leader Pierre Poilievre delivered a keynote speech Friday to kick off the party's national convention in Calgary ahead of a critical leadership review.
